get.description: Raw events for admin/governance-lifecycle symbols only (init, admin add/remove, threshold, policy, pause/unpause) — a public audit trail read straight off the chain. Optionally scoped to one contract deployment.

parameters.description: Restrict to one contract deployment id.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Filter by admin event symbol (issue #509). Must be one of ADMIN_EVENT_SYMBOLS; anything else is a 400.

get.description: Events whose fold handler threw deterministically and were isolated rather than retried forever (issue #43) — the operator-facing view of the quarantine. Never includes the raw exception text; that is logged, not returned, so this endpoint stays safe to leave unauthenticated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return (1-200, default 50).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Pagination cursor: return rows with a strictly smaller id than this value.

parameters.name: unresolved
parameters.description: When "true", only rows a reindex/replay has not yet resolved.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Only failures of events with this symbol (issue #192).

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Only failures from this contract deployment.

parameters.name: from_ledger
parameters.description: Only failures from this ledger onwards (issue #192).

parameters.name: to_ledger
parameters.description: Only failures up to and including this ledger (issue #192). With from_ledger, the range may span at most 10000 ledgers.

x-total-count.description: Rows matching every filter except the before cursor: the size of the whole quarantine, however far the page is (issue #192).

get.description: Read-only operator diagnostic over quarantine_state: consecutive whole-page failure count and escalation timestamp per tailed contract. Unauthenticated, like /admin/failed-events; raw error_message and all exception text are never returned. Use ?contract= to scope to one contract.

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Only the quarantine state for this contract id.

post.description: Acknowledges a recorded ledger discontinuity without rebuilding. Clears uncleared reorg halts and records the action into admin_audit_log (issue #402).

get.description: Lists every configured contract (CONTRACT_IDS, or the single CONTRACT_ID) with its last indexed ledger, observed RPC ledger tip, staleness and uncleared reorg halt. Unauthenticated operational diagnostic, consistent with /api/stats and /health. Cursor-write failures are not here: that map is worker-local — see the worker diagnostic listener documented in the README.

stale.description: True when the cursor has been idle longer than INDEXER_STALE_AFTER_MS.

status.description: cold_start means no cursor row yet; stale and ok follow /ready's staleness rule.

reorgDetected.description: True when an uncleared reorg halt exists for this contract.

contracts.description: Per-contract indexer health, present only with multiple CONTRACT_IDS.

get.description: Always 200 if the process is up — deliberately does no database round trip. Use /ready to check database and indexer freshness.

contract.description: Currently configured Soroban contract id, or null if unset.

get.description: Always 200 — a degraded dependency is reported in its own status field, not the HTTP status code. For dashboards/alerting; use /ready for the orchestrator pass/fail probe.

version.description: package.json's version, or 'unknown' if it couldn't be read.

commit.description: SOURCE_COMMIT env var, or 'unknown' if unset.

buildDate.description: BUILD_DATE env var, or 'unknown' if unset.

get.description: Prometheus exposition format (text/plain). Exposes ourdao_sse_connections (gauge: currently open SSE connections), ourdao_sse_connections_total (counter: SSE connections opened, ever), ourdao_sse_messages_total (counter: SSE messages written, labeled by event_type), plus Node.js default process/runtime metrics from prom-client.

Checks Postgres reachability and indexer freshness. 200 means ready (indexer 'cold_start' on an empty database is still 200 — see acceptance criteria). 503 covers every not-ready reason: postgres_timeout, postgres_unreachable, postgres_error, reorg_detected, indexer_stale.

reorg.description: Present only when reason is reorg_detected.

lastIndexedLedger.description: Present when reason is reorg_detected or indexer_stale.

observedTipLedger.description: Present when reason is reorg_detected or indexer_stale.

ledgersBehind.description: Present only when reason is indexer_stale.

estimatedLagSeconds.description: Present only when reason is indexer_stale.

secondsSinceUpdate.description: Present only when reason is indexer_stale.

staleAfterMs.description: Present only when reason is indexer_stale.
